W33

My course groups

/courses/:courseId/groups
Roles: studentScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S21, S15

Show the learner's course group memberships, assigned group work and any explicitly enabled self-enrollment. Course sections, grading allocation groups and learner project groups remain distinct concepts.

Entry and return
Course Groups navigationW19 unassigned-group guidanceW34 back to my groupsW14 group assignment card
Layout regions
Group overviewCourse/term and published group sets relevant to learner; Membership state and instructions from instructor
Membership cardsGroup-set name, own group, permitted member names and assignment links; Current membership versus past receipt-linked membership explained
Enrollment panelOnly if configured: eligible groups, capacity, opening/closing and consequences; Unassigned guidance when instructor assignment required

Stay unassignedJoin selected group
Permissions
  • Learner cannot create/delete group sets, move others or change grading policy.
  • Self-enrollment appears only when instructor explicitly published it; no implied default.
  • Past membership alone does not grant permanent access to future group work or others' individual grades.
Responsive
  • Group cards stack; member lists wrap with readable names.
  • Join review fits narrow web without drag/drop.
Accessibility
  • Group-set and own-group names remain explicit in headings.
  • Capacity/state is text; selection and confirmation work with keyboard.
Data
  • Published group set/membership and self-enrollment policy/window.
  • Group assignment references and authorized historical receipt links.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • An instructor-assigned set exposes no Join or leave workaround.
  • A group that fills after selection rejects join without changing existing membership.
  • Moving groups preserves prior receipt snapshots and does not reveal the new group's private prior submissions automatically.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
  • Self-enrollment is a conditional proposed variant; manual/random instructor assignment remains supported through W47.
